meta.title: Horizon AMS Reinvention — First 180 Days
meta.subtitle: Transition, QE, AIOps, CareOps360 & Agile/Product Model

tasks.task: Confirm transition charter, scope, governance cadence and 180-day success criteria
Establish integrated transition command center and daily/weekly operating rhythm
tasks.successMetric: Daily standups, weekly operating review, escalation path live

tasks.task: Validate in-scope applications, services, SLAs, owners and incumbent knowledge repositories
Complete access, environment, tooling and onboarding plan for IBM transition resources
Execute knowledge transfer wave 1 for critical applications and operations processes
tasks.successMetric: Critical apps have runbooks, support matrix and SME sign-off

tasks.task: Baseline current incident, request, change, defect and deployment metrics
tasks.successMetric: MTTR, ticket volume, backlog aging and SLA baseline captured

tasks.task: Map AMS towers to initial product/value-stream POD structure
Finalize interim run/support model and hypercare approach for first 60 days
tasks.successMetric: No service disruption; escalation path tested

tasks.task: Stabilize delivery governance, integrated risk log, dependency log and executive reporting
tasks.successMetric: Weekly reporting with risks, dependencies and KPIs

tasks.task: Complete knowledge transfer wave 2 for business-critical and medium-critical applications
Transition service delivery accountability to IBM POD/service leads with shadow-to-reverse-shadow plan
Implement SLA/CSL reporting pack aligned to business KPIs and operational metrics
tasks.successMetric: Business KPIs and critical service levels visible monthly

tasks.task: Optimize support model based on 60-day learnings and adjust staffing by product demand
tasks.successMetric: Backlog and incident queues balanced by domain

tasks.task: Launch transformation backlog intake for tech debt, ticket reduction and strategic initiatives
tasks.successMetric: Initiatives scored by value, risk and feasibility

tasks.task: Run first value realization review and confirm reinvestment / modernization candidates
Scale transition governance into product-centric monthly/quarterly operating model
tasks.successMetric: Product roadmap, KPI, financial and value governance running

tasks.task: Implement continuous improvement loop for incidents, RCA, automation and knowledge updates
tasks.successMetric: Repeat incidents trend down; RCA actions tracked

tasks.task: Finalize Year-1 transformation roadmap refresh using 180-day operating data
Execute 180-day transition health assessment and transition-to-steady-state acceptance
tasks.successMetric: Steady-state acceptance and remaining actions signed off

tasks.task: [QE] Mobilize QE transition team, clarify testing scope and confirm QE governance
[QE] Assess current test assets, automation coverage, defect leakage and regression cycle health
tasks.successMetric: Automation baseline, test pack gaps and defect trends documented

tasks.task: [QE] Define end-to-end QE strategy: shift-left, BDD/TDD, SIT, UAT support and non-functional testing
[QE] Inventory critical business flows and identify regression pack rationalization opportunities
tasks.successMetric: Top flows prioritized by business risk

tasks.task: [QE] Establish requirement-to-test traceability model in Jira/GitHub/toolchain
tasks.successMetric: Stories, acceptance criteria and tests linked

tasks.task: [QE] Define test data management strategy including masking, synthetic data and reusable gold copy
tasks.successMetric: Data privacy, reuse and refresh strategy approved

tasks.task: [QE] Identify service virtualization/stub needs for APIs, batch, file feeds and external dependencies
[QE] Stand up QE CoE operating model, standards, templates and metrics dashboard
tasks.successMetric: Common metrics and templates used by PODs

tasks.task: [QE] Rationalize existing regression suite and remove redundant / low-value tests
tasks.successMetric: Regression pack reduced without coverage loss

tasks.task: [QE] Implement AI-assisted test case generation pilot from requirements/user stories
[QE] Build automation framework enhancements for API, UI, component and batch regression
[QE] Create first automated smoke and regression packs for pilot product POD
[QE] Integrate automated tests into CI/CD gates for pilot cloud applications
[QE] Implement TDM self-service intake and data request tracker for priority domains
tasks.successMetric: Data request aging and reuse visible

tasks.task: [QE] Pilot service virtualization for top dependency-constrained flows
tasks.successMetric: Dependency wait time reduced for pilot flows

tasks.task: [QE] Launch defect prevention analytics: root cause categories, escaped defects and re-open trends
tasks.successMetric: Defect leakage and repeat causes tracked

tasks.task: [QE] Scale automation to additional product PODs based on business criticality
[QE] Deploy agentic QE workflow: requirements-to-test, test-to-BDD and BDD-to-automation
[QE] Expand non-functional testing model: performance, resilience, security and accessibility checkpoints
[QE] Establish continuous regression and release readiness scorecard
[QE] Conduct 180-day QE maturity reassessment and finalize scale roadmap
tasks.successMetric: Maturity improvement and next-wave roadmap approved

tasks.task: Confirm AIOps scope, target architecture, ARB/security path and first 5 AWS-hosted applications
Provision AIOps dev/test environments and connectivity pattern for Horizon ecosystem
Ingest historical ITSM ticket data and establish ticket taxonomy, resolution patterns and knowledge sources
Integrate ServiceNow/ClearQuest transition considerations and define ITSM workflow interfaces
Connect priority monitoring sources and logs for first cloud-app pilot set
Configure default AIOps dashboards for operations, leadership and product teams
Train initial models for alert grouping, noise reduction and auto-triage
Validate auto-triage for first 5 AWS-hosted applications with human-in-the-loop governance

tasks.task: Curate knowledge corpus from runbooks, SOPs, RCA and incident resolutions

tasks.task: Define controlled auto-remediation candidate backlog and risk guardrails
Standardize log, event and alert normalization across cloud applications

tasks.task: Onboard remaining cloud applications and selected on-premise systems to AIOps ingestion
Enable AI-assisted recommendations for high-volume incident categories
Pilot auto-healing for system-generated, low-risk incidents with audit trail
Expand proactive alerting and predictive insights before business impact
Integrate infrastructure logs and operational KPIs into single-pane AIOps view

tasks.task: Scale auto-recommendations toward 50% of incoming incidents for cloud applications
Scale runbook automation across top repeatable incident and service request patterns

tasks.task: Obtain ARB Light approval and define MVP deployment architecture
Deploy containerized CareOps360 to OCP/AWS dev environment
Provision RDS Postgres schema and baseline data model for dashboards

Configure dashboard layouts, KPI definitions and role-based page access
Conduct MVP playback and prioritize production hardening backlog
Promote MVP through Horizon release process with SSO and RBAC configured
Design target-state near-real-time architecture with Kafka/MSK and data contracts

tasks.task: Obtain ARB approval for target CareOps360 architecture
Define CareOps360 operating model, support model and product ownership cadence
Build ingestion platform in AWS using infrastructure-as-code, MSK and observability tools

tasks.task: Automate top 4-6 sources including ServiceNow, APM and Databricks
Enable previously-disabled dashboard tiles and validate data quality rules

tasks.task: Publish adoption plan, training assets and leadership consumption cadence
Migrate remaining sources including Contact Center, RPA and Provider Data Management
Activate AI Insights and Operations Copilot for trend explanation and next-best-action prompts
Implement write-back workflows to ServiceNow/Jira with guardrails and auditability
Harden for scale with HA/DR, CI/CD maturity, resiliency testing and support runbooks
Complete 180-day CareOps360 value review and next capability roadmap

tasks.task: Confirm agile/product transformation scope, leadership alignment and pilot selection criteria
Assess current work intake, prioritization, funding, release and governance practices

tasks.task: Establish product metrics dashboard: velocity, predictability, backlog health, value and quality

tasks.task: Scale agile ceremonies and product backlog model to next-wave PODs

tasks.task: Integrate DevSecOps 2.0 practices and quality gates into pilot / cloud app PODs
tasks.successMetric: Pipeline gates and security checks embedded

Expand product/value-stream governance into monthly portfolio and quarterly value reviews

tasks.task: Build product roadmaps for priority domains covering BAU, tech debt and transformation items
tasks.successMetric: Domain roadmaps aligned to business outcomes

tasks.task: Embed innovation sprint cadence and market/payer trend backlog intake
Optimize POD capacity model, talent rotation and skill evolution for AI/cloud/data needs
